evaluation.protocol: Compare pinned graphs. Embed documents in stable ID order and then in character-length order, same 32-row cap. Embed each judged query independently. Use fixed hybrid scores, tool-ID ties and family-paired intervals. Benchmark on CPU in independent process per graph. Development-only batch-sensitivity and prompt-latency probes.

acceptance.model_selection: Fixed candidates and gates. No holdout tuning. A positive screen needs a second CPU and larger independent evaluation before release.
